title: Daily digest: New Trident hotel to come up near Hydera | Mennonite Brethren Churches Elect New Go | Karnataka to write to Prime Minister ask
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: New Trident hotel to come up near Hyderabad airport by 2030.
Mennonite Brethren Churches Elect New Governing Council.
Karnataka to write to Prime Minister asking for inclusion of enhanced quota in Ninth Schedule.
bullets_ur: 2030 tak Hyderabad airport ke qareeb naya Trident hotel banaya jayega.
Mennonite Brethren Churches ne naye Governing Council ka intikhab kar liya.
Karnataka barhaye gaye quota ko Ninth Schedule mein shamil karne ke liye Prime Minister ko khat likhega.
